mentions.name: TypeQuicker
mentions.description: Typing practice web app that treats typing as an underrated, bottlenecking skill, especially in the age of LLMs. Users can practice typing code, use their own text, and on the paid plan use SmartPractice to type natural text targeting their weak points. Free to use and ad-free.
mentions.problem: The author was never fond of existing typing apps due to excessive ads and typing random words, and sees typing as a bottleneck, especially in the age of LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building TypeQuicker: https://www.typequicker.com

Typing is an extremely underrated skill and especially in the age of LLMs, it is the bottle neck in a lot of cases.

I’ve never been fond of existing typing apps; excessive ads, typing random words, etc so I built my own.

You can practice typing code, use your own text, etc

We have a paid plan for features where you can type natural text that targets your weak points (via SmartPractice) and many others. Other than that, it’s both free to use (and ad-free)
